مسنون: Rasulullah (صلى الله عليه وسلم) was reported to have said,
أن: Indeed, if a person were to perform an obligatory act within it, it would be as if he had performed seventy obligatory acts at other times.
فتيمما: But as for the time of...
وأجزأتك: I have fulfilled your obligation or discharged you from liability.
وسيرته: His life story or his conduct.
وجل:: And He is Almighty and All-Mighty
بلغني: It has been reported to me
لعنه: Upon him is the curse of Allah.
لقد: He was generous and kind to people, treating them with kindness and courtesy until he died, may Allah have mercy on him.
يتحاكم: They bring lawsuits against each other.
منها: Some of them are questions about Allah Almighty, and Sheikh al-Islam Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Taymiyyah, may Allah have mercy on him, answered them.
يُبَايِعُونَكَ: They will make a covenant with you

لعلة: Perhaps for a reason or cause.

أسطر: I have translated the Arabic phrase 'أسطر' into English as 'I write lines'.
